script.title: THE RENEWAL TALK
script.scene_zh: 管理辦公室 · 談續約
script.story_hook: A rent increase lands on the table today.
script.intro_zh: 漲租通知送來了，坐下來好好談。
script.welcome_en: Today we're negotiating a lease renewal. Listen and learn!
script.welcome_zh: 今天我們來聽一場續約談判。邊聽邊學！
script.outro: And that's how a renewal talk goes. Practice makes smooth!
script.outro_zh: 續約談判就是這樣。練習讓對話更順！
script.practice_intro_en: Time to echo the best negotiation lines.
script.practice_intro_zh: 來跟讀談判裡最實用的句子。
script.char_a_description: a tall middle-aged man in his fifties with a graying buzz cut, broad shoulders, and wire-frame glasses, wearing a faded red flannel shirt over a gray tee, work jeans, and scuffed brown boots
script.char_b_description: a stocky older man around sixty with thinning gray hair and a neat mustache, wearing a burgundy polo tucked into khaki chinos, a worn leather belt, and white athletic sneakers

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, Mr. Delgado. Thanks for meeting me.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈmɪstər dɛlˈɡɑdoʊ θæŋks fɚ ˈmitɪŋ mi/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，德爾加多先生，謝謝你抽空見面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, call me Luis. Have a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kɔl mi ˈluis hæv ə sit/
dialogue.zh: 別客氣，叫我路易斯就好。請坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, I got your renewal letter Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ ɡɑt jɔr rɪˈnuəl ˈlɛtər ˈtuzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是這樣，我星期二收到你的續約信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep. Did the number surprise you?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp dɪd ðə ˈnʌmbɚ spɚˈraɪz ju/
dialogue.zh: 對。那個數字嚇到你了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, eighty more feels like a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ˈeɪti mɔr filz laɪk ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，漲八十塊感覺太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole block went up, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl blɑk wɛnt ʌp ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你知道的，整條街的租金都在漲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know, but I've paid on time for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ bʌt aɪv peɪd ɑn taɪm fɚ jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，但我這幾年都準時繳租。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's true. You're my best tenant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts truː jʊrz maɪ bɛst ˈtɛnənt/
dialogue.zh: 這倒是。你是我最省心的房客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you consider a smaller bump?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju kənˈsɪdər ə ˈsmɔlər bʌmp/
dialogue.zh: 那能不能考慮少漲一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe. What did you have in mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wʌt dɪd ju hæv ɪn maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 也許可以。你心裡想的是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty, and I'll sign for two years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ænd aɪl saɪn fɚ tu jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 四十塊，而且我願意簽兩年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two years, huh... that does help me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː jɪrz hʌð ðæt dʌz hɛlp mi/
dialogue.zh: 兩年啊……這對我確實有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady rent saves you the turnover costs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi rɛnt seɪvz ju ðə ˈtɜrnˌoʊvɚ kɔsts/
dialogue.zh: 租務穩定，你就省了換房的成本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hate turning over units. Paint, cleaning...
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ heɪt ˈtɜrnɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ ˈjunɪs peɪnt ˈklinɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我最討厭重新整修房子。粉刷、清潔……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. Plus I'm not going anywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli plʌs aɪm nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɛniˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 就是啊，而且我也沒打算搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, forty-five for two years?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈfɔrti faɪv fɚ tu jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 好，那兩年、漲四十五？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-five... alright, I can live with that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti faɪv ɔˈlaɪt aɪ kæn lɪv wɪð ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 四十五……好吧，這我可以接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. But there's one thing I need.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt bʌt ðɛrz wʌn θɪŋ aɪ nid/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。不過我有件事要提。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me guess. The bathroom faucet.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɛs ðə ˈbæθˌrum ˈfɔsət/
dialogue.zh: 讓我猜，是浴室水龍頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've mentioned it twice already, yeah.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊz ˈmɛnʃnd ɪt taɪs ɔlˈrɛdi jɛ/
dialogue.zh: 你已經提過兩次了，沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The parts got back-ordered. Sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑrts ɡɑt ˈbæk ˈɔrdərd ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 零件缺貨延遲了，真抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll fix it myself this weekend. Deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɪks ɪt maɪˈsɛlf ðɪs ˈwikˌɛnd dil/
dialogue.zh: 這週末我親自修。成交？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, you'll do the repair yourself?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt jʊl du ðə rɪˈpɛr jʊrˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你要自己動手修？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I own the wrench set, believe it or not.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊn ðə rɛntʃ sɛt bɪˈliv ɪt ɔr nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我全套扳手都有，信不信由你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Okay, then we have a deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ oʊˈkeɪ ðɛn wi hæv ə dil/
dialogue.zh: 哈！好，那我們成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, what about parking? Rules are changing.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈpɑrkɪŋ rulz ɑr ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，停車怎麽辦？規定要改了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Changing? How so? Nobody told me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ haʊ soʊ ˈnoʊbəˌdi toʊld mi/
dialogue.zh: 要改？怎麼回事？沒人跟我說過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The city now allows street permits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪti naʊ əˈlaʊz strit ˈpɚmɪts/
dialogue.zh: 市裡現在開放路邊停車證了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, so guests can park legally?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ naɪs soʊ ɡɛsts kæn pɑrk ˈlɛɡəli/
dialogue.zh: 哦很好，那客人也能合法停車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right. I'll mail you a permit form.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt aɪl meɪl ju ə ˈpɚmɪt fɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 對。我會把申請表寄給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mother visits next month, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðɚ ˈvɪzɪts nɛkst mʌnθ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我母親下個月要來住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She can take spot seven when it's free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn teɪk spɑt ˈsɛvən wɛn ɪts fri/
dialogue.zh: 七號位空著時就讓她停那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's very kind of you, Luis.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈvɛri kaɪnd əv ju ˈluis/
dialogue.zh: 你真是太體貼了，路易斯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neighbors, right? Oh. Rent due day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈneɪbɚz raɪt oʊ rɛnt duː deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 遠親不如近鄰嘛。喔，說繳租日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still the first? I like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ðə fɚst aɪ laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 還是每月一號嗎？我不討厭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still the first. Same online portal.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ðə fɚst seɪm ˌɑnˈlaɪn ˈpɔrtəl/
dialogue.zh: 還是一號，線上繳租平台不變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I split it? Half mid-month, half end?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ splɪt ɪt hæf mɪdˈmʌnθ hæf ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 我可以分期嗎？月中一半、月底一半？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Um, the portal can do two payments.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðə ˈpɔrtəl kæn du tu ˈpeɪmənts/
dialogue.zh: 呃，平台可以分兩筆繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. My paycheck comes in two parts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɚfɪkt maɪ ˈpeɪtʃɛk kʌmz ɪn tu pɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我薪水也是分兩次的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That actually works fine. I'll note it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈæktʃuəli wɜrks faɪn aɪl noʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這完全沒問題，我記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question, sorry. The late fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛstʃən ˈsɑri ðə leɪt fi/
dialogue.zh: 再問一個，不好意思。逾期罰金呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty if it's over the fifth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ɪf ɪts ˈoʊvɚ ðə fɪθ/
dialogue.zh: 過了五號沒繳就罰五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. I'm rarely late.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf aɪm ˈrɛrli leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很公道，我很少遲繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've noticed. Quiet, too. Rare these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv ˈnoʊtɪst kwaɪt tuː rɛr ðiːz deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我看在眼里。又安靜，現在難得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign now or take it home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ saɪn naʊ ɔr teɪk ɪt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我現在簽，還是帶回去看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print it now. Coffee's on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɪnt ɪt naʊ ˈkɔfiz ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 現在就印出來，咖啡我請。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You had me at coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæd mi ət ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 聽到咖啡我就簽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's the pen. Initial each change, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz ðə pɛn ɪˈnɪʃəl itʃ tʃeɪndʒ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 筆給你。每處修改都請簽縮寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just the rent number and the dates?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə rɛnt ˈnʌmbɚ ænd ðə deɪts/
dialogue.zh: 只要簽租金數字和日期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the faucet promise, page two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈfɔsət ˈprɑmɪs peɪj tu/
dialogue.zh: 還有第二頁修水龍頭的承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see it. Written down. Great.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt ˈrɪtn daʊn ɡreɪt/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，白紙黑字，很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Verbal doesn't count, in my experience.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɚbəl dʌzənt kaʊnt ɪn maɪ ɪkˈspɪriəns/
dialogue.zh: 以我的經驗，口頭說的不算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sound advice. Two years, starting January.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊnd ædˈvaɪs tu jɪrz ˈstɑrtɪŋ ˈdʒænjuˌɛri/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。兩年，一月起租。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: January first. Same deposit, nothing new.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒænjuˌɛri fɚst seɪm dɪˈpɑzɪt ˈnʌθɪŋ nu/
dialogue.zh: 一月一號。押金不變，沒有新費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that felt almost painless.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðæt fɛlt ˈɔlˌmoʊt ˈpeɪnlɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這談得幾乎毫無痛苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Negotiating's just talking with a spreadsheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnəɡəˌʃieɪtɪŋz dʒʌst ˈtɔkɪŋ wɪð ə ˈsprɛdˌʃit/
dialogue.zh: 談判嘛，就是帶著試算表聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring the first check tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl brɪŋ ðə fɚst tʃɛk təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 明天我就把第一張支票送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush. Have a good holiday, Ray.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ hæv ə ɡʊd ˈhɑləˌdeɪ reɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不急。假期愉快，雷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You too, Luis. Say hi to Rita.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ˈluis seɪ haɪ tə ˈritə/
dialogue.zh: 你也是，路易斯。替我向莉塔問好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sure will. See you around the building.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ʃʊr wɪl si ju əˈraʊnd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一定帶到。大樓裡見。

script.youtube_description:
「Can I split it?」房東漲租，英文該怎麼開口商量？
這一集是60句完整的續約談判：漲幅、兩年約、修水龍頭、分期繳租、逾期罰金，一場對話全部聽懂。

你會學到：
・ polite ways to push back on rent（有禮地協商租金）
・ asking for repairs in writing（要求把修繕寫進合約）
・ payment dates and late fees（繳租日與罰金）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

請訂閱支持，下次和房東談話前先看一遍！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
Your landlord raised the rent. Can you talk them down? Learn the English for a lease renewal negotiation.
This episode is one full 60-line conversation: rent increase, two-year term, faucet repair, split payments, late fees.

You will hear:
・ polite hedging and counters in a negotiation
・ everyday housing money words
・ how a friendly deal gets signed

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

Subscribe for a new real-life English conversation every week!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
